description: NVIDIA (Santa Clara, California; founded 1993) publishes speech models under its Riva and Nemotron Speech lines: Parakeet, Canary and Nemotron ASR/Transcribe for speech recognition, Magpie for TTS and Nemotron VoiceChat for full-duplex speech-to-speech. Hosted trial endpoints are available with a free API key on build.nvidia.com; production deployment is via self-hosted Speech NIM containers governed by NVIDIA's software licence (NVIDIA AI Enterprise). Many of the models are also released as open weights on Hugging Face.
name: NVIDIA
